summary: Added createCraSloppyCommonJsGlobalsPlugin: dependency CJS modules are scope-analysed for names they write but never bind, and each gets a conditional globalThis binding so strict-mode ESM resolves the reference — reproducing webpack 4's shared implicit global, including cross-module reads. Application source and harmony modules untouched; unanalysable modules fail loudly. 11 new unit tests use the real-Vite-build-in-a-browser-realm idiom with strict output. Both HospitalRun lanes rebuilt x2 offline, deterministic, and both boot (target: zero console errors; baseline: known service-worker inventory only). Receipt and build profile regenerated under sha256(canonicalize(files)), recording all three runtime breaks and why the superseded digests were irreproducible. Full gate green.
